content.text: {"core": "Steward of Resonance senses what a room is actually feeling and tends to it. In Abstraction, that tending works on the ideas a mind builds to explain the feeling — the stories, the labels, the reasons. Balanced, the felt thing stays in the room while the idea gets built: the map keeps checking back against the water it maps. What is named still matches what is felt.", "sheetLine": "The name is built from the feeling and keeps checking back against it."}
